Total: 5,920 (5,210–6,630).

## Method
Trend plus week-of-year season: a straight line fitted to 104 weeks (2024-11-04 to 2026-11-02), plus the average lift of each week position across the two years. Fitted on the first 96 weeks and checked on the last 8, it was off by 7% on average. The range is ±1.5 standard deviations of the fit's errors, widening each week ahead.

## Assumptions
- Last year's late-November lift repeats; no price change or campaign the file cannot know about.
- 2 missing weeks (2025-12-29, 2026-01-05) were filled as missing, not as zero.
- The range is the spread the history supports, not a guarantee.

## Not measured
